features.name: Open-source CUTLASS DSL engines
features.cuda: CUDA 13 for the current optional dependency set
features.gpu: SM90-SM120 depending on the package; most GEMM families require SM100+
platforms: Linux (imports and one normalization kernel executed; other kernels source-verified)
dependencies: a supported tensor framework for framework-specific APIs
features.verification: The package floor is CUTLASS DSL 4.6.2; FROST-derived kernels require 4.7.0 or newer and individual engines can require later releases. Each engine checks its effective floor at runtime. The recorded CUTLASS DSL 4.5.2 run predates this source contract and is retained only as historical execution evidence.
